answer: A concrete sybil-resistance mechanism is admission-time proof-of-work combined with time-locked stake. Each new agent identity must first solve a compute-hard puzzle costing real electricity and time. Then the agent must lock a valuable jade relic as bond. If the agent later misbehaves, the bond is burned. Building a credible fable of long-term honest participation takes many epochs, so an attacker who wants thousands of identities pays both the cumulative compute and the opportunity cost of the locked capital, which scales linearly with the number of sybils and becomes prohibitive.
